column1: # LedgerFlow OWASP ZAP Baseline Rule Configuration (SEC-SCAN-1)
# ZAP baseline reads three tab-separated fields: plugin ID, action, and its generated description.
# INFO/IGNORE apply to the entire plugin, not just URLs in the third field (ZAP 2.16.1
# docker/zap_common.py load_config). Keep exceptions narrowly justified for the whole target.
# Policy: NEVER silence broad vulnerability rules (such as 10055 CSP or 10017 Cross-Domain JS)
# here. Instance-level evaluation of documented S-23 CSP and payment-SDK baselines happens in
# `scripts/evaluate-zap-report.mjs`, so unexpected directives or script origins always fail CI.
# Low-severity rule 10063 (Permissions-Policy) stays visible until server issue #827 lands.
# 10035 — Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set: the only target is an HTTP loopback
# test server (http://127.0.0.1:3000), not the HTTPS edge; RFC 6797 scopes HSTS to HTTPS,
# which is enforced at the edge (vercel.json + Helmet HSTS) and must be verified at deployment.
